sample_unit: benchmark questions (four medical reasoning benchmarks, including MedQA and MedXpertQA)
unlisted_practices: Training reward-model verifiers of LLM medical reasoning traces to iteratively query external medical corpora
Reinforcement learning with trace-level supervision and adaptive curriculum for verifier training
Using a verifier to select among sampled reasoning traces (best-of-N) to improve accuracy at lower sampling budget

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an agentic verification guardrail (tool-integrated iterative retrieval via reinforcement learning) to safeguard and verify medical reasoning outputs, tested against standard baselines across medical reasoning benchmarks.

primary.practice: tool-integrated iterative retrieval grounding for reasoning verification
